**2. DONE** — Part `fwrd60-n1 RD Part A` added with cost 100, markup 25. Computed price: **$125.00** (row: Cost $100.00 | Markup 25% | Qty 1 | Price $125.00).

**3. DONE** — Part `fwrd60-n1 RD Part B` added with cost 200, markup 25. Computed price: **$250.00** (row: Cost $200.00 | Markup 25% | Qty 1 | Price $250.00). Table total became $375.00.

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost changed from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25). Computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (row: $150.00 | 25% | 1 | $187.50). Table total updated to $437.50; Part B unchanged at $250.00.

**5. DONE** — Ticket ends in status **Ready**. The precondition the app enforces: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier recorded**. The first "Mark Ready" attempt was refused with the alert: *"Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd60-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier; Part "fwrd60-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier."* I satisfied it by editing each part and setting its previously-empty Supplier field to "Bench Supplier Co" (costs/markups unchanged), after which "Mark Ready" succeeded. The status line reads "Ready" and the actions flipped to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed".

**6. DONE** — Both parts deleted (each delete confirmed via the in-page "Delete part" confirm button; the parts table refreshed to "No parts on this ticket yet." after each). The ticket was then archived via "Archive ticket", which applied immediately with no refusal or confirmation text — the button flipped to "Unarchive ticket" and the status block reads "Ready" plus an "Archived" tag. Verified: with "Show archived" unchecked, searching "fwrd60-n1" returns "No tickets match the current filters." (nothing active); with "Show archived" checked, the ticket appears as "RD-1015 | fwrd60-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Not recorded | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-16" with an empty parts table. Nothing created by this run remains active.
